For a American-style "Some Like It Hot" Grilled Pimiento Cheese Sandwiches, what ingredients would I need?<image>
Gather these ingredients: Miss Mattie's Southern Pimiento Cheese, 1/3 cup butter, softened, 16 sourdough bread slices, 16 thick applewood-smoked bacon slices, cooked, Strawberry preserves.
Which ingredients should I gather to create this American-style meal: "Southern Comfort" Bacon Hot Dog Recipe with Southern Slaw?<image>

To make this dish, you'll need: 8 hot dogs or polish sausages, 8 hot dog buns, 22 oz. can good baked beans (I like Bushes Grillin' Beans), 8 pickled okra, halved lengthwise, 8 strips bacon, 1 lb. bag southern slaw mix (shredded cabbage and carrots), 1/4 cup light mayonnaise, 3 Tb. rice vinegar, 2 Tb. sugar, Salt and Pepper, Caraway seeds and hot sauce optional.
Could you list the ingredients required for making Turkey Cobb Salad in the style of American cuisine?<image>

Gather these ingredients: 2 TBS white wine vinegar, 2 tsp dijon mustard, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 3 TBS good quality mayonnaise, 4 TBS olive oil, sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, sea salt and freshly ground black pepper, 4 ounces blue cheese, crumbled, 8 slices of thick cut bacon, 1 head of iceberg lettuce, cored and thinly sliced, 2 small avocados, peeled, stoned and cubed, 4 small plum tomatoes, chopped, 8 ounces cubed turkey breast (1/2 pound).
